title: Tortillas
description: Homemade Mexican tortillas, perfect for tacos or other dishes. Made with simple ingredients and easy to prepare.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and crumbly bread.
Gradually add water while mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Heat a dry skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook each tortilla for 30-45 seconds on each side, until lightly browned and slightly puffed.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
